functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.game_chapter_event_text(p_site text, p_type text, p_enemy text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_result text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_site='mountain_village' then
    return case p_type
      when 'search' then '버려진 장작더미와 사냥꾼 은닉처를 뒤져 보급품 흔적을 찾았다.'
      when 'rest' then '목책 밖 바위 그늘에 숨어 숨을 고르고 주변 소리를 살폈다.'
      when 'track' then '진흙 발자국과 횃불 흔적을 따라 마을 순찰 동선을 추적했다.'
      when 'battle' then '목책 골목 교전 · '||coalesce(p_enemy,'인간 순찰대')||' — '||case when p_result='win' then '박멸 성공' else '저항에 밀려 후퇴' end
      else '산골 마을 외곽을 탐색 중이다.' end;
  elsif p_site='farm_road' then
    return case p_type
      when 'search' then '곡물 창고와 뒤집힌 수레 주변에서 운송 물자와 가죽 자재를 수색했다.'
      when 'rest' then '논두렁 아래 시야가 끊긴 곳에서 호위대가 지나가길 기다렸다.'
      when 'track' then '마차 바퀴 자국을 따라 행상인 호위대의 이동 경로를 추적했다.'
      when 'battle' then '마차길 교전 · '||coalesce(p_enemy,'호위대')||' — '||case when p_result='win' then '박멸 성공' else '호위대 반격으로 후퇴' end
      else '농촌 길목의 창고와 행상로를 탐색 중이다.' end;
  elsif p_site='border_outpost' then
    return case p_type
      when 'search' then '초소 보급상자와 무기 적재대를 노리고 감시탑 사각지대로 접근했다.'
      when 'rest' then '석벽 사각지대에서 횃불 순찰이 지나가길 기다리며 대열을 정비했다.'
      when 'track' then '감시탑 교대 신호와 발자국으로 초소 병력의 이동을 읽었다.'
      when 'battle' then '관문 교전 · '||coalesce(p_enemy,'왕국 병력')||' — '||case when p_result='win' then '방어선 돌파' else '초소 방어선에 밀려 후퇴' end
      else '변경 초소의 경계망을 피해 접근 중이다.' end;
  end if;
  return case p_type when 'battle' then '교전 · '||coalesce(p_enemy,'인간 세력') else '현장 상황을 확인 중이다.' end;
end $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.game_equipment_inventory()
 RETURNS TABLE(item_id text, enhance_level integer, qty bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select i.item_id,0::integer as enhance_level,i.qty
  from public.game_inventory i
  join public.game_item_defs d on d.id=i.item_id and d.slot is not null
  where i.player_id=auth.uid() and i.qty>0
  union all
  select e.item_id,e.enhance_level,e.qty
  from public.game_enhanced_inventory e
  where e.player_id=auth.uid() and e.qty>0
  order by item_id,enhance_level desc;
$function$

functions.args: p_player uuid, p_monster uuid, p_evolution text
functions.name: game_evolve_monster
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.game_evolve_monster(p_player uuid, p_monster uuid, p_evolution text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  m public.game_monsters%rowtype;
  evo public.game_evolution_defs%rowtype;
begin
  select * into m
  from public.game_monsters
  where id=p_monster and player_id=p_player
  for update;
  if m.id is null then raise exception 'monster_missing'; end if;

  if exists(
    select 1
    from public.game_expedition_members em
    join public.game_expeditions ge on ge.id=em.expedition_id
    where em.monster_id=m.id and ge.active=true
  ) then
    raise exception 'monster_busy';
  end if;

  select * into evo
  from public.game_evolution_defs
  where id=p_evolution
    and base_family=m.family
    and from_form_id=m.form_id;
  if evo.id is null then raise exception 'evolution_invalid'; end if;
  if m.level<evo.required_level then raise exception 'evolution_level'; end if;

  update public.game_monsters set
    form_id=evo.target_form_id,
    evolution_tier=evo.tier,
    skill_id=evo.skill_id,
    name=evo.target_name,
    hp_base=greatest(1,round(m.hp_base*evo.hp_mult)),
    atk_base=greatest(1,round(m.atk_base*evo.atk_mult)),
    def_base=greatest(0,round(m.def_base*evo.def_mult)),
    spd_base=greatest(1,round(m.spd_base*evo.spd_mult)),
    power_base=greatest(1,round(m.power_base*evo.power_mult)),
    crit_base=least(0.45,m.crit_base+evo.crit_add),
    evade_base=least(0.35,m.evade_base+evo.evade_add),
    evolved_at=now()
  where id=m.id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'formId',evo.target_form_id,
    'formName',evo.target_name,
    'tier',evo.tier,
    'skillId',evo.skill_id,
    'levelPreserved',m.level
  );
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.game_site_loot_capacity(p_player uuid, p_site text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select least(
    9000,
    3000 + greatest(
      0,
      (select count(*)::integer
       from public.game_expeditions ge
       where ge.player_id=p_player
         and ge.site_id=p_site
         and ge.active=true) - 1
    ) * 1500
  );

 RETURNS trigger

 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  new.name := case new.family
    when 'slime' then '슬라임'
    when 'goblin' then '고블린'
    when 'troll' then '트롤'
    when 'mandrake' then '만드라고라'
    when 'pixie' then '픽시'
    when 'imp' then '임프'
    when 'wisp' then '위습'
    when 'golem' then '골렘'
    when 'mimic' then '미믹'
    else coalesce(nullif(new.family,''),'몬스터')
  end;
  return new;
end
$function$

functions.name: game_sync_monster_form_name
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.game_sync_monster_form_name()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_form_name text;
begin
  if coalesce(new.form_id,'') <> '' and new.form_id <> new.family then
    select e.target_name
      into v_form_name
      from public.game_evolution_defs e
     where e.base_family = new.family
       and e.target_form_id = new.form_id
     order by e.tier desc, e.id
     limit 1;
  end if;

  new.name := coalesce(v_form_name, case new.family
    when 'slime' then '슬라임'
    when 'goblin' then '고블린'
    when 'troll' then '트롤'
    when 'mandrake' then '만드라고라'
    when 'pixie' then '픽시'
    when 'imp' then '임프'
    when 'wisp' then '위습'
    when 'golem' then '골렘'
    when 'mimic' then '미믹'
    else coalesce(nullif(new.family,''),'몬스터')
  end);
  return new;
end
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.game_trigger_party_skill(p_expedition uuid, p_round integer, p_hp_ratio numeric)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare r record; fired boolean;
begin
  for r in
    select m.id monster_id,m.name owner_name,s.*
    from public.game_expedition_members em
    join public.game_monsters m on m.id=em.monster_id
    join public.game_skill_defs s on s.id=m.skill_id
    where em.expedition_id=p_expedition
    order by s.damage_multiplier desc,em.position
  loop
    fired:=case r.trigger_type
      when 'chance' then random()<r.trigger_value
      when 'every_n' then r.trigger_count>0 and mod(greatest(1,p_round),r.trigger_count)=0
      when 'hp_below_chance' then p_hp_ratio<=r.condition_value and random()<r.trigger_value
      else false end;
    if fired then
      return jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'name',r.name,'owner',r.owner_name,'monsterId',r.monster_id,'damage_multiplier',r.damage_multiplier,'defense_ignore',r.defense_ignore);
    end if;
  end loop;
  return '{}'::jsonb;
end $function$
